**Alpha test build v1.3.0-alpha.2 — new sun logo, member details page, waiting sun** for the Mahuva Kshatriya Rajput Samaj community directory. For invited testers only.

- **MVPMI-v1.3.0-alpha.2-build….apk** (same file as **mvpmi.apk**) — install on Android phones (Android 10 or newer). It connects to https://samaj.kavigsv.com. Test-signed: **uninstall the previous app first**.
- **BUILD-INFO.txt** — version, build number, server. **SHA256SUMS.txt** — checksums.

New in this build:
- **New community sun logo** (full, symmetric) as the app icon, the logo on every screen and on the splash.
- **Member details** is now a full page: sun-crowned card, name in both languages, role, Call and WhatsApp, every number, native village and current residence, and "see all members from this village". Brick and saffron only.
- **Waiting sun** (turning rays with the hourglass) is back on the "Pending approval" screen.
- **No empty band at the top** on phones with a camera cutout (Pixel): the community logo and name are the first line.
- **Download page** shows the version and build, and the file name carries them (e.g. MVPMI-v1.3.0-alpha.2-build180.apk). Settings shows the version and build at the bottom.
- Fixed: the download page could hand out an older app (the reason the splash screen and new icon did not appear).

Tested: 138 server tests and 179 browser checks.
